heading: Short title.
text: NRS 102.010 Short title. This chapter may be cited as the Uniform Interparty Agreement Act. [6:36:1927; NCL § 3665]

heading: Interparty transactions validated.
text: NRS 102.020 Interparty transactions validated. A conveyance, release, or sale may be made to or by two or more persons acting jointly and one or more, but less than all, of these persons acting either by himself, herself or themselves or with other persons; and a contract may be made between such parties. [1:36:1927; NCL § 3660]

heading: Merger of obligation and right in contract.
text: NRS 102.030 Merger of obligation and right in contract. No contract shall be discharged because after its formation the obligation and the right thereunder become vested in the same person, acting in different capacities as to the right and the obligation. [2:36:1927; NCL § 3661]

heading: Fraudulent transactions.
text: NRS 102.040 Fraudulent transactions. Nothing herein shall validate a transaction within its provisions which is actually or constructively fraudulent. [3:36:1927; NCL § 3662]

heading: Chapter not retroactive.
text: NRS 102.050 Chapter not retroactive. This chapter shall not apply to conveyances, releases, sales, or contracts made prior to July 1, 1927. [4:36:1927; NCL § 3663]

heading: Uniformity of interpretation.
text: NRS 102.060 Uniformity of interpretation. This chapter shall be so interpreted and construed as to effectuate its general purpose to make uniform the law of those states which enact it. [5:36:1927; NCL § 3664]
